sentence: This project builds and checks a daily life measure of depression for persons with aphasia and looks at how it relates to communicative confidence.
This project studies what ankyrins and their protein partners do at cortical glutamatergic synapses, cortical circuits, and behaviors controlled by the frontal cortex.
This project provides viral vectors, CRISPR targeting vectors, and mouse lines to researchers studying the molecular and genetic basis of opioid addiction.
This project studies the function of receptors in astrocytes and how they affect synaptic function in brain regions relevant to neuropsychiatric disorders.
This project uses models of household data to study which demographic, behavioral, and environmental factors help or prevent influenza transmission in households.
This project studies the biological networks behind coronary artery disease.
This project sets up a synthesizer that makes specialized DNA and RNA molecules for researchers to test many chemically-modified sequences.
This project builds nanoparticles that deliver small molecules to senescent cells and combines them with immunotherapies to reverse the immunosuppressive microenvironment of solid tumors.
This project uses mouse models and patient-derived xenografts to find out how neuroendocrine bladder cancer works at the molecular level and to improve chemotherapy.
This project studies how human regulatory DNA works in mouse cells to learn how transcriptional regulation functions in different contexts.
This project builds a power analysis framework that helps scientists design spatial omics experiments.
This project looks at how inherited genetic variations affect tumor development and response to treatment in existing cohorts.
This project tests in cell and animal models whether genes or chemicals change the deficits caused by ethanol exposure.
This project tests whether docosahexaenoic acid in the diet lowers pulmonary inflammation caused by ozone exposure.
This project pairs laboratory studies with field investigations of filovirus ecology in bats to understand viral shedding and spillover to people.
This project develops a deep learning framework to find and genotype germline and somatic structural variants using data from different sequencing platforms.
This project optimizes engineered Salmonella bacteria to colonize tumors better and treat triple-negative breast cancer.
This project uses informatics and data science approaches to address challenges in health care and biomedicine.
This project tries to find out which thalamic neurons are activated during hyperalgesia and whether inhibiting them prevents it.
This project supports cancer research to identify, analyze, and validate targets for cancer therapy, diagnosis and prevention.
